chapter_note: Heavily damaged chapter (90.5% damage ratio) on whether light returns from the three strongholds. The substantive cosmological teaching describes light rays ascending through gates and firmaments, structured around four firmaments/cosmoi. Apostolic dialogue frame in segs 3 and 7 is straightforwardly editorial. The substantive question (segs 4-6) and the teaching response (segs 8-20) describe light's pathway upward — cosmological-substrate material describing cosmic mechanics. Despite the framing, the teaching itself maps cosmos→cosmos.
